selection_chain: Swash HintingInstance::new/reconfigure with HintingMode -> HintingOptions::from(HintingMode) -> Target.into() -> Engine::AutoFallback -> OutlineGlyphCollection::prefer_interpreter -> TrueType glyf prefer_interpreter predicate -> Interpreter or Auto(None).
scope: 55 unique unmodified TrueType faces:39 aggressive candidates+Rye/Vollkorn controls, plus14 previous CJK faces. Source predicate uses declared maxp instruction maximum and raw fpgm/prep table lengths, not observed glyph program bytes. It identifies the preferred engine when hinting is enabled; font programs can subsequently disable hinting. Zero TT VM dispatch does not imply absence of native runtime autohint work. This audit neither measures execution cost nor supplies an empirical cache-admission threshold.
